State, health, Solix, image, property and safety consumers subscribe privately. Device automation triggers continue to use the public bus. eufy_sdk_floodlight_safety is unchanged.

presentation.last_person: Unrecognized personDetected displays Human; Stranger and recognized names remain unchanged. Four existing assertions updated.

diagnostics_sensor.reason: No definition or 20-second diagnostic poll exists in the provided integration checkout. Live attributes cannot be measured without prohibited host access. Config-entry diagnostic export and bridge diagnostics remain unchanged.

recorder_estimate.basis: Owner audit rate approximately 17 propertyEvidenceChanged messages per second; no live measurement performed.
recorder_estimate.limits: event_data reuse and other simultaneous state changes reduce savings; event totals and switch/camera state totals are separate. Other suppressed telemetry is not quantified.

validation.lint: Ruff passes for all changed integration modules and the new routing tests; legacy test files have pre-existing style findings. git diff --check passes.
validation.scope: No SSH, HA API, cloud, push, installation or service actions. Offline Python audit rejects connections, subprocesses and writes outside this repo during test execution. Windows platform cache is warmed before the audit to avoid a platform-detection fallback subprocess during collection.
